import numpy as np
from scipy.optimize import least_squares
lT=np.log(T); le=np.log(eps)
def basis(q):
    f,h,m=q
    cols=[le, lT*le, (1-np.exp(-f*eps)), lT*(1-np.exp(-f*eps)), eps, eps*lT, T, T**2, lT, np.ones_like(T), eps*T**2]
    return np.column_stack(cols)
def res(q):
    A=basis(q); c=np.linalg.lstsq(A,sigma,rcond=None)[0]
    return A@c-sigma
best=(1e9,None)
for f0 in [0.3,0.7,1,1.5,2,3,5]:
    r=least_squares(res,[f0,0,0],max_nfev=500)
    v=np.mean(r.fun**2)/np.var(sigma)
    if np.isfinite(v) and v<best[0]: best=(v,r.x)
q=best[1]; A=basis(q); c=np.linalg.lstsq(A,sigma,rcond=None)[0]
